item.description:
Acquia Announces AI-Ready Brand DAM Optimization and Related Events

Acquia is hosting a series of events and workshops in September and October 2026, including a session focused on optimizing Digital Asset Management (DAM) for AI-ready brands.

⚙️ Key details

Event Date Location
Optimizing Your DAM for the AI-Ready Brand Thursday, September 24, 2026 Virtual
Acquia DAM Workshop: Navigating The New Era of DAM in NYC 30 September, 2026 New York City, NY, United States

🚀 Availability

Other scheduled events during this period include:

  • Acquia Summer Party: 15 September, 2026 in London, United Kingdom
  • Designing LADWP’s Website for All of Los Angeles: Wednesday, September 23, 2026 (Virtual)
  • DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026: September 28, 2026 – October 1, 2026 in Rotterdam, Netherlands
  • Acquia Partner Summit at DrupalCon Rotterdam 2026: 29 September, 2026 in Rotterdam, Netherlands
